about: Shows analyzed. v1 includes only shows that publish their own timed transcripts in their feed. To add a show, add an entry; to remove one at a show's request, set "paused" to the reason (its pages come down on the next build). See OPERATIONS.md. include_titles / exclude_titles (regular expressions) keep other shows, replays and best-ofs that share a network feed out of a show's numbers.
